title: Invitation tickets are counted as collected revenue at full price
description: Invitation approval stores price = ticket type price, discount 0, is_paid = true; revenue sums price - discount over is_paid tickets.
actual_behavior: Each invitation adds the full ticket price to event and platform revenue.
recommendation: discount_amount = price, or exclude payment_method='invitation'; add a report test.

title: Deleting a ticket type cascade-deletes all its tickets, including paid and checked-in
description: tickets.ticket_type_id is cascadeOnDelete and TicketTypeController::destroy deletes with no guard.
evidence: create_tickets_table.php:16; app/Http/Controllers/Admin/TicketTypeController.php:61; tests/Feature/Admin/TicketTypeCrudTest.php:187-190 only asserts the type is gone
expected_behavior: Deletion blocked while tickets exist (deactivate instead).
actual_behavior: All tickets, answers and workshop bookings of that tier are permanently deleted.
recommendation: restrictOnDelete migration + guard in destroy(); point admins to is_active.

title: Ticket, speaker and sponsor reviews lack a server-side Pending guard
description: updateStatus sets the new status regardless of the current one; only the Blade buttons are hidden for non-pending rows.
evidence: TicketRequestQueueController.php:49-59; SponsorRequestController.php:55-64,72; SpeakerRequestController.php:42-53,61. Runtime (rolled-back txn): approving a TicketIssued ticket -> status payment_pending; approving the same sponsor request twice -> 2 sponsors.
expected_behavior: Reviewing a non-pending request is a no-op.
actual_behavior: Issued tickets are demoted (attendee refused at check-in, QR rotated on re-payment); duplicate speakers/sponsors created.
recommendation: lockForUpdate + early return unless Pending (as Admin/InvitationRequestController.php:52-57 does); add double-review tests.

title: Coupon usage_limit is check-then-increment
description: find() checks times_used < usage_limit; recordUse() increments unconditionally later.
expected_behavior: A coupon is never redeemed more than usage_limit times.
actual_behavior: Concurrent requests can both redeem the last use.
recommendation: Conditional atomic increment and check affected rows.

title: Payment completion races on double visit and loses the ticket email on mail failure
description: Read status, then write ticket_id without lock; mail sent after update with no retry.
expected_behavior: One ticket_id, one email, retried on failure.
actual_behavior: Two visits can issue two QR codes (one invalid); a mail exception after the update means the email is never sent.
recommendation: Conditional UPDATE WHERE status=payment_pending + queued mailable afterCommit.

title: Payment is a stub: opening the signed link issues the ticket without charging
description: Placeholder until a gateway is integrated; GET link can be triggered by email link scanners.
expected_behavior: Ticket issued only after payment is captured.
actual_behavior: Any approved request becomes a paid ticket on link open.
recommendation: Integrate a gateway with webhook confirmation, or document free/offline payment as an accepted decision.

title: No pagination anywhere in the admin
description: Every list uses ->get(); the ticket queue eager-loads answers.field for all tickets.
evidence: grep paginate -> none; TicketRequestQueueController.php:31-35; Admin/ContactMessageController.php:15; Admin/NewsletterSubscriberController.php:15; SpeakerRequestController.php:26; SponsorRequestController.php:27
actual_behavior: Memory and render time grow with every request received.
performance_impact: Linear in rows; risk on shared hosting at thousands of requests

title: Ticket issuance implemented in three places
description: Reference number, QR secret, workshop key and TicketIssued email duplicated.
actual_behavior: Changes must be made in three places.
recommendation: Extract TicketIssuer service (fixes CR-05 and INV-C02 in one place).

title: Reports issue per-event / per-ticket-type aggregate queries
description: 3-4 aggregate queries per type/event and one per status.
evidence: EventReport.php:86-94; PlatformReport.php:59-66; measured 34 queries (event report) and 35 (platform) locally

title: 18 UI strings have no Arabic translation
description: Keys used in views but missing from ar.json, plus two en-only keys.
evidence: Missing: e.g. Ahmed Hassan, name@example.com, Enter your code, Follower count, View All Speakers, Featured, Require influencer category on ticket requests, Featured on the landing page (up to 4), Only :max speakers can be featured at once., Category, Social, We received your request, We received your request., Influencer Category, Other, Tell us your category, TikTok; en-only: 'Thank you for your interest in', 'Unfortunately, we're unable to approve your ticket request at this time.'
actual_behavior: English fallback in the Arabic locale.
recommendation: Add keys; add a translation coverage test for event/admin views like HubTranslationCoverageTest.

title: Dead views, JS entry and dependency
description: admin/check-in/index+result views, welcome view, resources/js/bootstrap.js (never imported) and the axios package it alone uses; empty tests/Feature/Feature/Admin; TicketStatus::Approved never assigned.
evidence: view reference scan; grep import bootstrap -> none; app/Enums/TicketStatus.php:10
recommendation: Delete after confirming; keep TicketStatus::Approved only if planned.

title: Approved speaker shares the application's photo file; deleting the speaker deletes it
description: Approval copies photo_path; destroy deletes the stored file.
actual_behavior: Image broken on the archived request.
recommendation: Copy the file on approval or reference-check before deleting.

title: Public speaker application bio has no length limit
actual_behavior: Up to ~30 MB of text per field.

title: Session written on every request by SetLocale
description: Every visitor/crawler hit writes a DB session row.
expected_behavior: Write only when the locale changes.
recommendation: Only put() when the value differs.

title: Event slug accepts any characters
actual_behavior: Spaces or ?/# produce broken event URLs.

title: Status labels built with __(ucfirst($value)) instead of enum labels
description: Mixed labelling approaches; caused the 'Used' key clash fixed in 1d00644.
actual_behavior: Translation keys shared across unrelated meanings.
recommendation: Add label() to remaining status enums and use it.

title: Payment completion (ticket issuance for paid requests) has no test
description: No test hits tickets.payment; only the link inside the approval email is asserted.
expected_behavior: Happy path, invalid signature, idempotency and mail failure covered.

title: Deleting an event deletes all its tickets without a count warning
recommendation: Show 'N paid tickets will be deleted' or block when tickets exist.
